Listen to this article Share …Urge Abians to come out enmass to welcome Obi, as he visits Aba Advertisement Advertisement Nkechi Nwaogu, Abia Central Senatorial candidate of the Nigerian Democratic Congress (NDC), has commended Governor Alex Otti for his peaceful disposition that has enabled all political parties to campaign freely in the State without intimidation. She described Abia State as the most peaceful in the country and appealed to security agencies and the State Government to give the NDC the necessary support for a peaceful and successful visit of Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso,his vice presidential candidate, its Presidential candidate, to Aba, the State’s commercial hub, scheduled for Friday, November 27, 2026. Nwaogu, who is the State Coordinator of the NDC Presidential Campaign Council for Abia State, while briefing newsmen on Obi’s planned visit to Aba, described the visit as a home coming for its Presidential candidate. According to her, “This is not just a campaign visit. This is a home coming. Abia is Obi’s home. Abia is where the Obidient Movement was born. Abia is where the cry for a new Nigeria started. “Our brothers and sisters in Aba, the business hearthbeat of Nigeria, will have the opportunity to sit, eat and discuss with Peter Obi. He will listen to traders, manufacturers, shoemakers, tailors and youths. He wants to hear how we can rebuild Aba, rebuild trade and make business work again. Advertisement “Nigerians are tired. Abians are tired. Our youths have no jobs, our businesses are suffering, our naira has lost value, federal roads are bad, our hospitals are empty, while our schools are struggling.” She said that Obi is not coming to Abia just because he is a Presidential candidate, he is coming with a plan to encourage production, boot consumption, a plan for education, health,security and job creation. Advertisement “Obi is coming with a plan, where government money will be used for the good of the people , not stolen by the few” she stated. Nwaogu called on Abians and other residents to come out enmass to welcome Obi and Kwankwaso to Aba.
